title: Async Interrupt
text: Generate Versa Module Eurocard (VME) interrupt service routines (ISRs) that execute downstream subsystems or Task Sync blocks, 1 input, 1 output, {Timer size} sets Number of bits to store the clock tick; {VME interrupt number(s)} sets the vME interrupt numbers for the interrupts to be, {VME interrupt vector offset(s)} sets the interrupt vector offset numbers corresponding to the VME interrupt, {Simulink task priority(s)} sets the priority of downstream blocks; preemptable-1; Preemption flag(s); preemptable-1; Preemption flag(s); preemptable-1; Preemption flag(s); preemptable-1; Preemption flag(s); preemptable-1; Preemption flag(s); preemptable-1; {Preemption flag(s); preemptable-1; non-preemptable-0} sets the selects preemption, {Manage own timer} selects timer manager, {Timer resolution (seconds)} sets the resolution of ISR and {Enable simulation input} selects add simulation input port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: VME interrupt number(s)
params.values: VME interrupt numbers for the interrupts to be installed [1 2] (default) | integer array

params.name: VME interrupt vector offset(s)
params.values: Interrupt vector offset numbers corresponding to the VME interrupt numbers [192 193] (default) | integer array

params.name: Simulink task priority(s)
params.values: Priority of downstream blocks [10 11] (default) | integer array

params.name: Timer size
params.values: Number of bits to store the clock tick 32bits (default) | 16bits | 8bits | auto

params.name: Enable simulation input
params.values: Select add simulation input port on (default) | off
